notes.title: Miner Tower Defense will become free soon
notes.notes:
Dear players,
This game has not had new sales in months. So in order to make it develop better, I decided to set Miner Tower Defense to be free in the near future. Hope everyone enjoy themselves when playing!
Best wishes!

notes.title: New updates on Nov 19th
notes.notes: In this update, I fixed some bugs and adjusted the difficulty of certain levels appropriately. Hope this game continue to bring happiness to every miner!

notes.title: Updates on November 15th
notes.notes: In the new version, we have fixed some bugs and adjusted the difficulty of some levels.

notes.title: Important Updates
notes.notes: Due to a bug in the engine used to make the game, Miner Tower Defense was unable to play while your PC is connected to the internet. We have now resolved this issue.

notes.title: Updates on June 13, 2024
notes.notes: We enrich beginner tutorials to enable players to better get started with the game.
